events.title: GOLDEN: 50 Musical Seasons of the Abu Dhabi Choral Group
events.price_text: Adults AED 100, under 18s AED 50 (Raha staff and families 50% off). Tickets cash at the door or from cast members
events.description: The Abu Dhabi Choral Group celebrates its 50th season with five decades of songs from the musicals. Evening shows Thursday to Saturday at 7:30 PM, plus a Saturday matinee at 2:30 PM.

events.title: Curating the Commons: Socially Engaged Public Art – book launch
events.venue: The Art Gallery Reading Room, NYU Abu Dhabi, Saadiyat Island
events.description: Book launch and conversation with author Katia Arfara and Shuddhabrata Sengupta (Raqs Media Collective) about public art projects she curated in Athens and how socially engaged art uses shared public space.

events.title: Acid Arab live – Public Art Abu Dhabi Biennial
events.description: Live concert by Acid Arab, blending electronic beats with Arab sounds, as part of the Public Art Abu Dhabi Biennial programme.

events.title: Coastal Narratives and Material Heritage – Biennial talk
events.venue: NOMAD Abu Dhabi, Terminal 1, Old Abu Dhabi Airport
events.description: Panel discussion on memory, migration and cultural knowledge with Asuncion Molinos Gordo, Khalid Al Banna and Nujoom Alghanem, moderated by Arnaud Morand. Part of the Public Art Abu Dhabi Biennial.

events.title: Open Studios: Güliz Gürel & Doris Tao at MiZa
events.description: An encounter between science, art and movement: an optical installation by MiZa resident Güliz Gürel with a movement improvisation by resident Doris Tao.

set.venue: The Art Gallery Reading Room, NYU Abu Dhabi, Saadiyat Island
set.description: Arts Chat with UAE-based artists Alysia Knowles, Eman Al Hashemi and Yousif Hassan about the opportunities and challenges of building a career as an artist. Attendance by invitation request.
